notes: TopModul DTS3 ELGa correction support v329. DTS3 keeps ServoForge's internal stopped-reference/correction planning model but presents correction turns as ELGa (Electronic gear, absolute). ELGa Parameter 1 is the target DTS3 table position on the 0-45 command domain and Parameter 2 is the absolute plate-angle target; the previous plate position is carried into the move. Existing TopModul two-consecutive-correction support remains available. Autocol, MultiModul, and DTS4 command presentation remain unchanged.
